description: Track anime and manga on MyAnimeList: search the database, read title details, browse the top-anime and top-manga rankings and any broadcast season, and get the suggestions MyAnimeList picks for your account. Read and update your own anime and manga lists (status, score, episodes or chapters, start and finish dates, tags, and notes), remove entries, read any public profile's lists, browse the forums, and read your profile and watch statistics.
